notes: Najda is the one who wrote («أن نجدة الحروري كتب إلى ابن عباس») and is in the scene; Ibn Abbas, who gives the answer, is the last link (rule 6).

The second isnad («حدثنا بذلك علي بن خشرم ... بهذا») gives a different transmitter (al-Awza'i) with a different content («أسهم النبي للنساء»): marked variant, but it is a second saying with its own isnad, so it is flagged for ruling (rule 11).
